snippet.title: Embers of the UncrownedㅣOfficial Cinematic Trailer : An Elf
snippet.description:
Embers of the Uncrowned is a dark fantasy MMORPG where fast-paced, satisfying isometric view combat meets brutal, gory visuals.
On a continent devastated by the elven invasion, embark on a journey to reignite your fallen house's last ember of hope.

A playable demo arrives soon. 
Add to your Steam Wishlist to be the first to know.

Learn more: 
🎮 Steam Wishlist: https://nexon.link/bpV
💬 Discord: https://nexon.link/bpZ
💌 X : https://nexon.link/bpY
🌐 Official Site: https://nexon.link/bpE
